subject: add researchers to study 3880
body:
Dear Nora,

Thanks for contacting us.

Regarding your goal, that is the exact page you need to have access to invite other researchers. If you are either the owner or a permission manager of the study 3880, you should be able to access the new "Researchers" page. If you're none of them right now, you need to ask the owner to "Promote you to Permission Manager" via that page.

That said, if you are already the owner or a permission manager and you still cannot access that page, would you please provide a screenshot of what is being presented to you? Also, it would be so much helpful if you could include the "Console" tab of the "Developer tools" of your browser (you can open it by pressing F12 or cmd + option + i on macOS).

Best regards,
MohammadReza

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25130/68af245d8b0d70a5
